system: Compare land-cover changes in two separate regions, Example and Candidate. Each has two local original-RGB views, T1 then T2. Thin red contours mark included support; enclosed holes are excluded. The drawn support boundary itself is not an object structure. Infer land cover before and after in each region from RGB evidence. Reply JSON only. Reverse transitions and unchanged regions are not matches. Two numerical evidence lines provide auxiliary model predictions, not ground truth. Check the directed change in RGB; probabilities and similarity alone do not establish a match.
question:
